description: email.rs find_immutable_patch_key (~line 1218): for every patch key, iterates all 21 IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS entries linearly. O(patch_keys × 21) per Email/set update call. At scale (batch updates with many patch keys) this is quadratic in the patch map size. A static phf::Set or a lazily-initialized HashSet would make each key lookup O(1), reducing the whole function to O(patch_keys). The static list is already a compile-time constant so this is straightforward.
title: find_immutable_patch_key: O(n*m) double loop vs HashSet
